_documentation.model_purpose: Consolidated METAR Station Personality Fact Store. Provides pure quantitative behavioral profiles, dimensional semantics, credibility ratings, and exact empirical meaning for all 11 market weather stations to accelerate agent decision-making.

credibility_rating_system.ANECDOTAL: N <= 2 episodes. Unstable, cannot support autonomous trade decisions.
credibility_rating_system.LOW: 3 <= N <= 5 episodes. High variance, indicative pattern only.
credibility_rating_system.MODERATE: 6 <= N <= 10 episodes. Acceptable as secondary confirmation filter.
credibility_rating_system.HIGH: 11 <= N <= 20 episodes. Statistically sound, candidates for p < 0.05.
credibility_rating_system.ROBUST: N > 20 episodes. Institutional-grade sample size, high predictive stability.

time_stop_calibration.methodology: Empirical P95 resolution on continuous SPY OHLCV 1993-2026.

d4_persistence_duration.finding: Persistent episodes (>=4 bars) exhibit higher structural win rates (+4 to +8pp) on zz50/zz75 but carry higher initial tactical drawdown (MAE) on zz25. Flash episodes (1d) represent tactical whipsaws or micro-reversals.

tail_overflow_tier_impact.finding: Overflow episodes (>3sigma) represent 4.11% of data. Delta win rate in overflow states is -0.7%. Tail events provide extreme asymmetric R:R but require widest stops.

evaluation_additional_dimensions.d3_discriminative_verdict: D3 (intra-indicator vol) shows tight delta (+-2.8pp) across bins globally. It acts as a volatility gate/modulator rather than a primary directional trigger.
